zh: 新增工具与技能快捷操作菜单：支持在首页工具卡片、嵌入工具框架及工作区中呼出右键/操作菜单，提供重命名、置顶与删除等便捷操作。
技能与工具中心（Skill Hub）排序与分类增强：支持按最新添加、最近更新和名称多维度排序，联动工作区自定义工具分组准确展示。
优化嵌入工具框架与全屏生命周期：统一自定义工具和 Skills 的回调处理，修复工具视图切换及全屏模式下的状态同步体验。
en: Added tool and skill context menu (HomeToolMenu): supports context actions including rename, pin, and delete across cards, frames, and workspace.
Enhanced Skill Hub sorting and category discovery: added multi-dimensional sorting by newest, recently updated, and alphabetical order.
Optimized embedded tool frame and fullscreen lifecycle: unified callback handlers and state synchronization for custom tools and skills.
